thread:
incident-bot: SEV 2 - Increased p99 tail latency and streaming stalls observed in eu-west-1. Auto-alert: kv.prefill.eviction_rate exceeded threshold.
maya: seeing spikes on /v1/streaming/chat, p95 ~450ms but p99s up to 8-12s for streaming responses.
sam: confirmed. metric: kv.prefill.eviction_rate spiked 4x at 10:12 UTC. also high KV decode queue depth.
toni: are we losing KVs or just fragmentation? logs show a lot of partial slab allocation failures and prefill tasks waiting.
devan: customer reports: partial streaming chunks then pause, some resumptions, others time out. Support ticket #6421 getting noisy.
henry: rolling aggregator shows hot shards for certain customer prefixes — heavy prefill for long-history chats.
maya: hypothesis: prefill path is overwhelming KV slab allocation, decode tasks starving streaming decode threads -> tail stalls.
sam: can we throttle prefill queue for low-priority sessions? runbook suggests toggling prefill_rate_limit.
toni: trying safe throttle: `curl -X POST http://ops-config/prefill -d '{"rate_limit":0.4}'`
ops-bot: config change applied to eu-west-1 prefilling: rate_limit=0.4
alex: immediate metrics show decrease in prefill tasks queued, eviction_rate down slightly.
maya: p99 streaming latency dropped from ~11s -> ~6.5s, still above SLO. we need more.
devan: can we disable predecode for streaming endpoints? that reduces decode pressure.
henry: safe toggle: `POST /feature-flags/streaming_predecode false` — will impact cold calls but better than tail failures.
ops-bot: feature flag updated: streaming_predecode=false for eu-west-1
sam: after flag off, p99 down to ~3.1s and streaming stalls rare. p95 stable ~350ms.
maya: customer impact update: affected customers (3 enterprise tenants) saw degraded streaming; two auto-recovered post-mitigation, one still seeing intermittent 2-3s stalls.
support-bot: notified customers via status page: incident 6110000000, note added with timeline and mitigation steps.
toni: long-term: need to rebalance slab allocations and fix KV allocator fragmentation. opening follow-up ticket.
henry: also need smarter prefill prioritization: avoid full-history prefill for idle sessions and use progressive background prefill.
devan: will schedule a patch to compact slabs during low traffic and increase kv_slab_chunk_size for eu-west-1 pool.
maya: handoff to primary oncall for follow-up: @sam taking next 8h.
sam: acknowledging handoff. will monitor and coordinate postmortem.
maya: postmortem owners: sam (lead), henry (kv allocator), devan (prefill), toni (runtime)
maya: add runbook note: when kv.prefill.eviction_rate > 3x baseline -> throttle prefill, disable streaming_predecode, consider slab compaction.
incident-bot: incident transitioned to 'mitigated' at 6110001800. next steps: perf postmortem, customer RCA, and a code fix deploy window.
